LESSON: KITCHEN LAYOUTS AND EQUIPMENT

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: HOME SCIENCE FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Food and Nutrition
Topic 1.2: Kitchen Layouts and Equipment
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Kitchen Layouts and Equipment, part of Food and Nutrition in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 HOME SCIENCE FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: How does a kitchen layout enhance efficiency? 2. How do we care for kitchen tools and equipment?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to Learn: the learner reflects on their work while sketching different kitchen layouts and as they improvise

kitchen tools and equipment.

● Critical thinking and Problem-solving: the learner chooses the option they think is most effective in terms of

materials to use as they improvise kitchen tools and equipment.

Values:
• Responsibility: the learner cares for their tools and equipment and those of others as they clean and store kitchen

equipment.

• Unity: the learners promote team spirit as they carry out group tasks when improvising kitchen tools and

equipment.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Health Promotion Issues: the learners promote health when caring for kitchen tools and equipment through cleaning.
